lines.en: Holy mackerel... am I glad to be back.  Gave me some time to really think, y'know?  'Bout what I'm doin' in this life.
lines.zh: 我的妈耶……我可真高兴终于回来了。 那边可给了我不少时间让我反思，你懂吧？ 关于我这辈子都在干些啥。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Really!  And what have you concluded?  Does a new, clean-living Stefan stand before us?
lines.zh: 是嘛！ 你的结论是？ 站在我们面前的这位斯泰凡，是一个崭新的、浪子回头的斯泰凡啦？

lines.en: Oh... you mean the drinkin', the flirtin', and the thievin'?  Likely to continue, friend.  No, no, think bigger!  Some give me the label ‘thief’ but look around us!  We live in a world of schemers, snakes, and dealmakers.  At least a thief bears his soul to the world for all to see, without all the misdirection.  They should make me the patron saint of Truth itself, I tell you.
lines.zh: 噢……你是说喝酒、调情和顺手牵羊吗？ 怕是停不了啦，朋友。 不不不，想深一点！ 有些人给我贴上“小偷”的标签，但看看我们周围吧！ 我们生活在一个充斥着阴谋家、骗子和掮客的世界里。 至少小偷让大家都看到了他的灵魂内在，毫无遮掩。 他们就应该让我当真理的守护神才对，我跟你讲。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: ...You are as eloquent as they come, Stefan.
lines.zh: ……你的口才真是举世无双，斯泰凡。

lines.en: Bah, no patience for a little philosophy I see.  Well, how 'bout this?!
lines.zh: 切，看来你没耐心体味哲学啊。 嗯，那对这个呢？！
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Very nice.  Now you're almost as fast as your lightning quick wit.
lines.zh: 挺好的。 现在你动作的速度差不多都能赶上你思维的速度了。

lines.en: Heh heh heh... yeah!  ... Wait a minute...
